data.name: God Is Not Here
data.detailed_description:
I, the one writing these lines, am a dead man. I am dead quite officially, in full accordance with the law: I died and was not buried. Ask those who saw the final minutes of the recording about me, and they will tell you that I became one of the victims of that house; that after the night of the investigation I was never found, neither alive nor dead; that in the reports my name has long been listed among the missing. And yet — I am here. I breathe. I hear my own voice. I remember the cold of the door handle, the smell of damp in the corridor, and the moment I understood: the house did not want to kill me. It wanted to leave me inside — in endless madness.

God Is Not Here is a story-driven first-person horror game focused on a dark atmosphere, the exploration of an abandoned house, and paranormal events. The player will step inside, examine the surroundings, search for traces of what is happening, and interact with objects while gradually sinking into the story of the house.

The free demo includes the first chapter of the game and lets you enter the house where it all began.

data.short_description: “My God, my God… why have You forsaken me?” — Psalm 22:1. Words spoken by Jesus Christ on the cross before His death.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains scenes of graphic violence, blood, and death. The setting is dark and oppressive, with disturbing imagery and mild strong language. Some scenes may be emotionally intense or unsettling for sensitive players.
